title: Mayor Owens Announces Changes in the SHA Board
summary: Mayor Sharon F. Owens announced the resignation of Ryan Benz from the Syracuse Housing Authority (SHA) Board of Commissioners and appointed Bethaida 'Bea' González, a civic leader with 40+ years of experience in governance and community engagement, to replace him. González brings expertise in intergovernmental collaboration, housing policy, and equitable access initiatives relevant to SHA's expanded development agenda.
